reference: Independent deterministic bundle ledger and local Parquet SQL

analyses.title: Release: monthly sales
sql: SELECT month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM `project-e8b1593d-009a-4822-abf`.agentic_bi_demo.sales_orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

analyses.title: Release: 2024 follow-up
sql: SELECT month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM `project-e8b1593d-009a-4822-abf`.agentic_bi_demo.sales_orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date <= CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

analyses.title: Release: daily history
sql: SELECT c.calendar_date AS order_date, COALESCE(SUM(o.revenue), 0) AS revenue FROM `project-e8b1593d-009a-4822-abf`.agentic_bi_demo.calendar AS c LEFT JOIN `project-e8b1593d-009a-4822-abf`.agentic_bi_demo.sales_orders AS o ON c.calendar_date = o.order_date AND o.status = 'completed' WHERE c.calendar_date >= '2023-01-01' AND c.calendar_date <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY c.calendar_date

analyses.title: Release: cross-source segments
sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM `project-e8b1593d-009a-4822-abf`.agentic_bi_demo.sales_orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id
SELECT customer_id, segment FROM retail_timeseries.customer_profiles WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
